services.desc: Make Paper Buildings for Your Layout (2024 Div 2 Meeting) This paper is a summary of a presentation by MVRRHS member Wally Venable at the NMRA Division 2 Meeting hosted by Mon Valley Railroad Historical Society on 17 March 2024. It is a discussion of how paper buildings can be made and modified from existing books or downloaded images using common graphics software, a desktop scanner and a cheap inkjet printer. In addition, the paper contains several structures which may be printed and assembled directly from the .PDF file. These ready to print buildings include a simple Company House in O, HO, and N scales, a one-room schoolhouse in HO, and a Company Store in N along with scale rules in O,

blurb: The Mon Valley Railroad Historical Society is a 501(c)(3) organization formed in 1987. Our mission is to preserve railroad history in the Mon Valley with detailed modeling, educational displays, and public outreach. The group has grown from a handful of enthusiasts to more than 40 members.
